## Description
Used in [Create In-World Text](/wiki/articles/create+in-world+text). Specifies which of this action's inputs will be constantly reevaluated. The text will keep asking for and using new values from reevaluated inputs.

## Options
- **Color** 
- **None** 
- **String** 
- **String and Color** 
- **Visible To** 
- **Visible To and Color** 
- **Visible To and Position** 
- **Visible To and String** 
- **Visible To, Position and Color** 
- **Visible To, Position and String**
- **Visible To, Position, String and Color** 
- **Visible To, String and Color**
